_comment: Apps the hub offers. pack-apps zips each one into a verified package and writes the catalog.
hubNotes: Saw Forge Studio 1.1.1 (beta): a new Folk pianist, chords that follow key and major/minor changes, and a more realistic Session Pianist (half-pedalling, una corda, velocity curves and microphone perspectives). Regions on a track no longer stack on top of each other.

apps.name: Saw Forge Studio
apps.description: Arrange, record and mix with the Saw Forge wavetable synth, Worship Atmospheres pads, the Session Pianist (beta), virtual EDM drummers, take comping and automation.
apps.notes: Beta: Session Pianist. New: the Folk pianist, with Twinkling Ostinato and Strummed Folk styles, plus a Folk genre and Nostalgic mood in the Chord Composer. Changing the key now moves the chords, and Major/Minor turns them into the new mode's chords (G D Em C becomes Gm D Eb Cm). The piano gains Soft Grand and Una Corda characters, half-pedalling, soft pedal (CC67) and expression pedal (CC11), velocity curves for your MIDI keyboard, microphone perspectives, room size, pedal noise and a Realism control. Fixed: MIDI, Drummer and Pianist regions no longer pile up on top of each other. Moving, pasting or duplicating a region onto another one now trims the one underneath, like other DAWs.
